summary.text: Jon Brien is an independent state representative from District 49 who took office on January 3, 2023 and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists him as an attorney who earlier represented District 50, from 2007 to 2013.

paragraphs.text: Brien was born in and lives in Woonsocket, Rhode Island.

According to Ballotpedia, he earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Rhode Island in 1993, a J.D. from New York Law School in 1997 and an M.B.A. from Suffolk University in 2001, and his professional experience includes working as an attorney.

Ballotpedia lists Brien as having served in the Rhode Island House for District 50 from 2007 to 2013, including as chair of the Municipal Government Committee during the 2011-2012 session, and as having taken office for District 49 in 2023.
